def fit(x, y, m):
    from scipy.optimize import least_squares
    b = np.column_stack((np.ones(len(x)), x))
    w = np.ones(len(x), bool)
    for _ in range(4):
        r = np.linalg.norm(b @ np.linalg.lstsq(b[w], y[w], rcond=None)[0] - y, axis=1)
        w = r < max(0.06, 4 * np.median(r))
    ps = []
    for j in range(4):
        p = np.zeros(12)
        p[1] = 1.0
        p[3] = 1.0
        p[j + 4] = 0.25
        z = least_squares(lambda p: pred(p, x[w], j, m) - y[w, j], p, loss='soft_l1', f_scale=0.015, max_nfev=400).x
        ps.append(z)
    return (np.array(ps), w)
